solutions.title: Iterative expansion
solutions.strategy: Start with an empty prefix and extend all current prefixes for each digit.

timeComplexity.explanation: There can be up to 4^n combinations and each produced string has length n.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The result list stores every generated string.

solutions.title: Backtracking prefix
solutions.strategy: Build one prefix in-place and append a string when its length reaches the digit count.

timeComplexity.explanation: The search emits up to 4^n strings and copies n characters per result.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output dominates; the recursion prefix adds O(n) auxiliary stack space.
